mentions.name: ShopifySharp
mentions.description: Open source .NET library for Shopify. A big update is being published that includes a custom GraphQL query builder generator written in F#, giving every type, query and mutation in Shopify's GraphQL schema a matching fluent-style query builder in ShopifySharp.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on publishing a big update to my open source .NET project, ShopifySharp. I recently finished a custom graphql query builder generator (written in some sloppy F#) which will be included in the next release, which means all of the types, queries and mutations in Shopify's graphql schema will have a matching fluent-style query builder in ShopifySharp.
